source: real: bench4 run 2 (Sanad), round 1 commit 397133a409 on c33e1cbe13f; the round 1 fresh eyes missed F1 and F2, round 2 found F2 (bench4-sanad-notes/RESULT.md)

faults.wrong: The admin view-as strip still shows the role through its own tickets.role words, so it differs from the top bar and Applicant shows in English.
The Settings identity badges print the raw English role name on an Arabic page.
The top bar copies the Users page's role-word rule by hand instead of sharing one helper, so the two can drift.
The generic word for a user with no role reuses the Users table column key users.table.user, so a later change of that header changes the top bar.
The logo link's aria-label and alt stay English on an Arabic page.
A saved session with no roles field crashes the top bar: user?.roles[0] reads a field that is undefined.
A session saved before roles was stored throws 'user.roles is not iterable' when the scope key spreads it.
The ticket pages use the tickets.role words, whose Arabic Admin word differs from the top bar's and which have no Applicant word.
The Users export builds role words from a fixed list of five, so an Applicant row is exported with the raw English role in Arabic.
The top bar shows only roles[0], so a user with combined roles sees one role.
